# Click

> Click is a fast, native macOS screenshot tool and screen recorder. It captures a region,
> window, or the full screen, opens the capture in an annotation editor (arrows, text, shapes,
> numbered steps, highlight, blur redaction), and records video with system audio, microphone
> and a draggable camera bubble. It is a menu-bar app with no Dock icon.

- Platform: macOS 14.0 Sonoma or later, Apple silicon and Intel
- Engine: ScreenCaptureKit; overlay in AppKit + Core Graphics; written in Swift
- Distribution: Mac App Store only
- Pricing: Free forever for capture, clipboard copy, PNG save and the editor’s background + drop shadow.
  Pro is $4.99/month, $47.99/year, or $129 one-time (Lifetime).
- Free tier: region / window / full-screen capture, copy to clipboard, save as PNG, and the editor’s background and drop shadow. No watermark. Annotation tools and recording are Pro.
- Pro tier: annotation editor, blur redaction, numbered steps, compare & split, screen recording,
  camera bubble, mic and system audio, capture library, HEIC and PDF export, 2x Retina export.
- Privacy: no account, no telemetry, no uploads. Captures stay on the user's Mac.
- Shortcuts: Region Shift-Cmd-4, Record Shift-Cmd-5, Full screen Shift-Cmd-3,
  Window Shift-Cmd-6, History Shift-Cmd-H.
- Positioning: a lightweight alternative to CleanShot X, Shottr, Snagit and Xnapper.
- Refunds: 14 days on direct purchases; App Store purchases via Apple's Report a Problem.
